Visit the island to the south

zh: %s 第一次来到自己的那块地，说起想在这里做的事。
en: %s visited her own patch for the first time and shared a plan.

zh: 南边有玻璃花园和暖暖的露台，要一起去度假吗？
en: There is a glass garden and a warm terrace to the south. Shall we go on holiday?

zh: 南边有泳池和海边秋千！一起去度假嘛！
en: Pools and seaside swings to the south! Let us go on holiday!

zh: 南边已经有休息的地方了。今天去放松放松吧。
en: There is a place to rest in the south. Let us relax there today.

zh: 南边适合看海。想一起去。
en: The south is good for watching the sea. I would like to go together.

zh: 花廊和玻璃窗……想邀你来坐坐，慢慢看云。
en: The flower walk and glass windows… come sit with me and watch the clouds.

zh: 风帆屋顶！泳池！秋千！这里每一样都想和你一起玩！
en: A sail roof! A pool! Swings! I want to try everything here with you!

zh: 宽门廊正好歇脚。到了这里，就把活儿放一放。
en: The broad porch is perfect for resting. Let us leave work behind while we are here.

zh: 树上的观星台。晚上，一起看星星吧。
en: A stargazing deck in the tree. Let us watch the stars tonight.

zh: 那座「{name}」，是我们商量好以后建起来的。
en: We planned “{name}” together. Then I built it.
